name: nirav-managemant
description: Nirvaana House - Angular frontend (studio-management/) + Node backend (BE/) + Tauri desktop

scripts.repo:first-push: git push -u origin main && git push origin v1.0.0
scripts.repo:force-push: git push -u --force origin main && git push --force origin v1.0.0
scripts.push: git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -q -m build) && git push origin main
scripts.desktop:build: npm run push && git tag -f desktop && git push -f origin refs/tags/desktop && echo "Desktop build triggered. Open your GitHub repo -> Actions tab -> the newest run -> wait ~15 min -> download the .dmg / .msi / -setup.exe from Artifacts."
scripts.desktop:help: echo "Steps: 1) create an EMPTY GitHub repo  2) npm run repo:connect -- https://github.com/USER/REPO.git  3) npm run repo:first-push  4) for every later build: npm run desktop:build"
